many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

import os,re,json
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # separator color: non-bg color forming full rows or full cols
    sep=bg
    best=0
    for v in cnt:
        if v==bg: continue
        tot=sum(1 for r in range(h) if all(g[r][c]==v for c in range(w))) + sum(1 for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c]==v for r in range(h)))
        if tot>=1 and tot>best: best=tot; sep=v
    rsep=[r for r in range(h) if all(g[r][c]==sep for c in range(w))]
    csep=[c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c]==sep for r in range(h))]
    cells=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg and g[r][c]!=sep]
    if not cells: return g
    rs0,rs1=min(p[0] for p in cells),max(p[0] for p in cells)
    cs0,cs1=min(p[1] for p in cells),max(p[1] for p in cells)
    def stamp(off_r,off_c):
        for dr in range(rs1-rs0+1):
            for dc in range(cs1-cs0+1):
                val=g[rs0+dr][cs0+dc]
                if val!=bg and val!=sep and 0<=off_r+dr<h and 0<=off_c+dc<w: res[off_r+dr][off_c+dc]=val
    res=[row[:] for row in g]
    stamp(0,0)
    for r in rsep: stamp(r+1,0)
    for c in csep: stamp(0,c+1)
    return res
inp=G['Demo pair 1 input']; out=G['Demo pair 1 output']
print(f(inp)==out)
test=G['Test input']
print(json.dumps(f(test)))

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sep=None;best=-1
    for v in cnt:

        tot=sum(1 for r in range(h) if all(g[r][c]==v for c in range(w))) + sum(1 for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c]==v for r in range(h)))
        if tot>=1 and tot>best: best=tot; sep=v
    rsep=[r for r in range(h) if all(g[r][c]==sep for c in range(w))]
